title: Sprite Gibber - a tool to destroy any pixel art into pieces! #gamedev
author: Melodic_Charity_1770
selftext:
Get it here: [https://reactorcore.itch.io/sprite-gibber](https://reactorcore.itch.io/sprite-gibber)  
~~Many animals were harmed in making this video, I am sorry~~

Jokes aside, I built this originally with Claude Sonnet, then finished it up with Opus later. It works on the seemingly basic principle of "shatter this sprite into voronoi chunks, apply color and physics to said chunks over time", which is surprisingly versatile technique.

Originally I just wanted classic UT2004 style meat gibs and blood for sprites, but then I escalated and added fire, acid, ice and many more presets, even a randomizer that effectively gives infinite animations to create with a single click.
